turns.content: You maintain a Python worker. Inspect the relevant source before proposing an edit. Keep replies short and name the affected function.

Use rows[offset:offset + size]. The stop index is exclusive.
Exercise test_pages_exact to confirm the boundary. Use the test tool.

requests.content: A batch iterator advances the cursor by the requested size even when the last read returns fewer entries. A caller persists the cursor after each page and resumes after restart. Explain how this can skip later arrivals and propose a regression test that appends entries between two reads.
